digest.component_or_area: code-review gate, Pass-1 concurrency specialist overlay
propositions: Code review currently lacks a concurrency rubric to detect race conditions, leaving gaps in detecting unlocked-twin races like raw git rm+commit sequences and TOCTOU patterns on lockfiles

A two-tier lexical trigger mechanism (committed high-precision tokens + project-extensible noisy tier in criteria_routing.json) must fire the concurrency overlay deterministically on diff hunks bearing synchronization primitives or project-specific vocabulary

The overlay must enable project-specific extension of trigger vocabulary through .rebar/criteria_routing.json without code changes, allowing repos to layer repo-specific tokens (e.g. index.lock, stage_and_commit) to catch modal race classes

The committed high-precision tier deliberately does not fire on unlocked-twin races (raw git rm+commit, getmtime+os.remove on index.lock), with that recall boundary delivered by project-extensible routing, documented as an accepted design split

The concurrency overlay must ship advisory (block_threshold 0.95, blocking_enabled false) and surface findings via Pass-1 review with lockset-first rubric heuristic (inconsistent synchronization discipline on same resource)
